title: Rays Farms
description: Rays Farms is a client-only Fabric mod that puts a searchable, in-game library of RaysWorks' farms — with one-click links to his tutorial videos — behind a single keypress.
body:
# Rays Farms

*A Minecraft Fabric mod by ArSi.*

Rays Farms is a small but clever companion mod that gives you a searchable, in-game library of farmable items — complete with direct links to tutorial videos. No more Alt-Tabbing into YouTube to remember how that one farm worked. Press a key, search, click, build.

> **All farms featured in this mod are designed by [RaysWorks](https://www.youtube.com/@RaysWorks).** This mod is an in-game index that surfaces his work — full credit for every farm goes to him.
>
> The complete farm catalogue lives in this public Google Sheet:
> 👉 [Rays Farms — Source Spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1S3jBzfy_PtJhQI_5jFIN3lXBiUEMebt_rT2x5os2MYw/edit?pli=1&gid=1671671217#gid=1671671217)

---

## Why Rays Farms?

Anyone who builds in Minecraft knows the drill: you need a specific resource, you think "there has to be a farm for this", and then you lose half an hour searching wikis and old videos. Rays Farms cleans that up.

- **All your farm ideas in one place** — no scattered bookmarks.
- **Always up to date** — the list lives in an online spreadsheet, not in the code. New entries appear instantly, no mod update required.
- **One click to the tutorial** — every entry can carry a video link.
- **Stays out of your way** — client-only, no server install, no game state changes.

---

## Features

- **In-game menu** with a hotkey (default: `R`).
- **Live search** across name, item ID, category, and farming method.
- **Categories & farming methods** displayed for every entry.
- **▶ Video markers** on entries that have a tutorial. Click to open the video in your browser.
- **Reload button** to re-fetch the list without restarting Minecraft.
- **Dedicated keybind category** *Rays Farms (by ArSi)* in Options → Controls → Key Binds — fully rebindable, never collides with vanilla bindings.
- **Client-only** — works on any server, even vanilla ones.

---

## How it works

On startup, the mod downloads [this public Google Sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1S3jBzfy_PtJhQI_5jFIN3lXBiUEMebt_rT2x5os2MYw/edit?pli=1&gid=1671671217#gid=1671671217) as CSV and parses it into a searchable list. Each entry contains a display name, item ID, category, farming method, and (optionally) a tutorial URL. Everything happens on the client — no separate server runs, no save data is touched, no packets are sent to the server.

All farm designs come from **[RaysWorks](https://www.youtube.com/@RaysWorks)**. The video links inside the mod open his tutorials directly.

---

## Requirements

| Requirement | Version |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | 26.1.2 |
| Fabric Loader | 0.19.2 or newer |
| Fabric API | matching your MC version |
| Java | 25 or newer |

> **Note:** Without the Fabric API, the mod won't load. You can find it on Modrinth as well.

---

## First steps in-game

1. Load any world (singleplayer or a server — both work, the mod runs client-side).
2. Press **`R`**.
3. The Rays Farms menu opens.

> The first time you open it, the mod automatically downloads the current list from the internet. If you're offline, the list will be empty — once you're back online, the **Reload** button has you covered.

---

## The menu at a glance

![Screenshot of the Mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97a9346cc4a56ccdea3b571587cb11fc0ae8c789.png)

- **Search field:** filters in real time across name, item ID, category, and farming method.
- **Reload:** re-fetches the list — no game restart needed.
- **Status line:** shows hit count, loading state, or an error.
- **▶ Video:** the entry has an attached tutorial. Clicking it opens the video in your default browser.
- **Close:** closes the menu (`ESC` works too).

---

## Customizing the keybind

The mod ships its own dedicated category in Minecraft's controls so it never collides with vanilla bindings.

1. **Options** → **Controls** → **Key Binds**.
2. Scroll down to the category **Rays Farms (by ArSi)**.
3. Click next to **Open Rays Farms Menu** and press your preferred key.
4. Confirm — done.

> Tip: If your chosen key is already bound, Minecraft highlights the conflict. Either rebind the other action first, or pick a free key.

---

## Multiplayer & servers

Rays Farms is a **client-only mod**. You don't need to install it on the server — and you won't get kicked if the server doesn't have it. It doesn't change game state and doesn't send any packets.

---

## Updates

Content (new items, new videos) is maintained through the online spreadsheet. You receive updates automatically via the **Reload** button or on the next start — **without a mod update**.

Code updates (new features, new MC version) are released here on Modrinth.

---

## Common issues

**"Mod won't load / game won't start"**
- Make sure your launcher is using Java **25+** (not the system-wide Java 8/17).
- Verify that **Fabric Loader 0.19.2+** and the **Fabric API** are installed.
- Versions must match Minecraft 26.1.2.

**"List is empty / shows Error"**
- Check your internet connection.
- Click **Reload**.
- If the status keeps showing "Error", restart Minecraft once — the source is a public online spreadsheet and can rarely be unreachable for a moment.

**"The R key already does something else"**
- Either rebind the conflicting action, or bind Rays Farms to a free key (see *Customizing the keybind*).

**"Clicking a video does nothing"**
- Minecraft opens links via your system's default browser. If you don't have a default browser set, configure it in your OS settings.

---

## Who is it for?

- Players who regularly build farms and want a quick reference.
- Content creators and server admins who want to hand a curated list to their community.
- Newcomers who want to dive into Minecraft farms without long research sessions.
